title: Quartermaster Pro
description: Manage multiple ledgers tracking contents of containers. Quickly search and find items.
body:
New Menu to manage Ledge, Default keybind O  
You can create new Ledgers  
Delete Ledgers  
Merge 2 or more Ledgers into 1 Ledger  
Rename Ledgers  
View items in ledger  
Export list to csv file  
Search items in preview  
When you click an item any containers containing the item will be highlighted  
You can also highlight all containers in Ledger  
Now supported nested containers such as bundles and shulkers
